title: haenelia scabrida
intro: Haenelia scabrida, commonly known as the Scabrous Haenelia, is a species of lichenized fungus in the family Haeneliaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Haenelia scabrida include its potential to act as a immunomodulator and an antiviral agent, making it a promising candidate for the development of new medicines. The bioactive constituents of this plant include compounds such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
